primaryEngine.responseType: rule-based / template-based / content-retrieval (no LLM or generative AI)
primaryEngine.generatorCount: 150+ template fragments across 14 action handlers + 40 NLP pattern-match routes + 6 domain-specific pattern maps + 5 hint levels

capabilities: Session recording with per-QID attempt metadata
Weakness cluster detection (persistentWeak, declining, unstable, hintDependent, difficultySensitive)
Learner intelligence engine (S134 — single access point)
Threshold registry (S133 — single source of truth)

coachingCapabilities: Wrong-choice coaching (per-distractor: whyTempting, whyWrong, misconception, avoidNextTime)
Graduated hints (5 levels: metacognitive → concept → strategy → elimination → full)
contextAvailable: Case context (case title, item index, exhibits)
contextMissing: Real-time difficulty adjustment per question instance
Live defect manifest sync (uses hardcoded list of 5 known-defective QIDs)
Question-bank content quality metrics (DL-008/DL-026 status for rendered items)
uiComponents: Sidebar insight panels (readiness, case patterns, practice mix, stats)

gapsIdentified.impact: All responses are template-based with data interpolation; May cannot generate novel explanations or adapt to unexpected learner queries beyond the 50+ pattern-matched routes.
May excludes 5 hardcoded known-defective QIDs from recovery sets but does not sync with DEFECT_MANIFEST_DL008_DL026.json. Static list will rot as defects are fixed or discovered.

gapsIdentified.gap: Recovery sets don't filter by Certified state
gapsIdentified.impact: QID recommendations don't enforce question_state === 'Certified' — Unprocessed or In Audit items could appear in practice recommendations.
Practice recommendations are accuracy-based only, not forgetting-curve-based. Missed opportunity for evidence-based learning science.
Cannot detect hesitation patterns, speed-accuracy tradeoffs, or provide time-management coaching per Blueprint domain.

gapsIdentified.gap: Early hint levels generic, not distractor-aware
gapsIdentified.impact: Hint levels 1-3 use generic section-aligned templates rather than distractor-specific clues from the question's ExplanationWrong fields.
On narrow screens, sidebar insight panels are hidden via CSS display:none, losing all readiness/case pattern/practice mix data.

gapsIdentified.gap: No difficulty calibration from learner data
gapsIdentified.impact: Difficulty labels are template-assigned; no empirical adjustment from learner success rates.
Learners cannot compare performance to peers. No platform-level difficulty calibration data.
Coaching quality improvements are made without empirical validation. No mechanism to compare template variants or measure satisfaction.
All UI, coaching, and question content is English-only. No localization framework.

gapsIdentified.gap: LocalStorage quota risk on pilot logs
gapsIdentified.impact: cmaMayPilotUsageLog, cmaMaySafetyLog, cmaMayGateLog, cmaMaySessionTelemetry all grow unbounded (capped at 100 entries but no total-size monitoring).

risks: Any LLM integration must extend S107/S108 anti-leakage validation suite (currently validates against 5 patterns)
Action handlers tightly coupled to renderView() — async LLM calls require loading states and progressive rendering
Per-question time tracking requires modifying app.js exam flow — regression risk to core exam engine
Recovery set generation assumes global QUESTION_BANK variable exists — fragile dependency
Current architecture is entirely client-side — adding server-side component is a significant architecture change
May's tutoringPilotEnabled flag (default: false) and _guardedSpeak() infrastructure already exist — use these as the gate
